calculation.description: Ranks instruments by their 20-day return, preserving magnitude while reversing the signal when the 60-day return is negative. This rewards short-term momentum aligned with the medium-term trend and expresses contrarian preference when the medium trend is negative. Values use only closes through the observation date.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.023064), 2023-2024 (0.067318), 2025-2026 (0.011945), and 2027-2028 (0.002713), but negative in 2029 YTD (-0.027017), indicating recent sign drift. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
